audience.text: Developers who generate or modify PowerPoint presentations on servers or in build pipelines and need a lightweight, MIT-licensed dependency that operates entirely within the Office Open XML format.

capabilities.text: The Presentation class serves as the root of the object model, supporting creation from scratch or loading existing .pptx files, with save support for PPTX, PPSX, and POTX formats.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Add AutoShapes, PictureFrames, Tables, and Connectors via ShapeCollection methods, with support for 190 ShapeType values and comprehensive formatting options.
capabilities.title: Add and format shapes

capabilities.text: Format text at Portion, Paragraph, and TextFrame levels with font properties, alignment, bullets, and frame formatting.
capabilities.title: Format text content

capabilities.text: Apply eight visual effects including outer shadow, inner shadow, glow, soft edge, reflection, blur, preset shadow, and fill overlay via EffectFormat.
capabilities.title: Apply visual effects

capabilities.text: Add, clone, remove, and hide slides; support threaded comments with multiple authors, timestamps, and positions.
capabilities.title: Manage slides and comments

capabilities.text: Embed images from file, bytes, or InputStream via ImageCollection and addPictureFrame; manage speaker notes via NotesSlideManager.
capabilities.title: Embed images and add notes

limitations.text: No support for charts, SmartArt, OLE objects, video, audio, animations, transitions, group shapes, hyperlinks, sections, slide backgrounds, themes, or slide size configuration.
Save() only supports PPTX, PPSX, and POTX; all other SaveFormat values raise UnsupportedOperationException with clear error messages.
A known defect exists where cloning a master slide via getMasters().addClone() reports a size increase but does not persist the clone to the saved package.
Text language attributes are not written to the generated .pptx files, leaving PowerPoint to apply the authoring machine's default language.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PowerPoint file generation and modification without Microsoft Office, COM automation, or native code dependencies.
Preserves unknown XML content during round-trip operations, ensuring no silent data loss when loading and saving presentations.
Provides a stable, deterministic build process with reproducible artifacts and comprehensive test coverage across multiple operating systems and Java versions.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Java is a pure Java library for creating, reading, and editing PowerPoint .pptx presentations without requiring Microsoft Office or native dependencies.

uncertainties: The relationship between the public API symbol 'Relationship' and actual PowerPoint relationship handling is not fully explained in the examples.
Whether Table.mergeCells() works with all table types beyond XML-backed tables is not explicitly confirmed.
The exact behavior of save() when given invalid slide indices or empty arrays is not demonstrated.
How unknown XML parts are preserved verbatim during round-tripping is not detailed beyond the general claim.
The scope of 'threaded comments' support beyond basic creation and positioning is not fully specified.
Whether all 190 ShapeType values produce distinct XML tokens is not fully verified in the examples.
The exact behavior of clone operations on slides with complex content is not demonstrated.
How the library handles malformed or non-standard .pptx files during loading is not specified.

workflows.name: Create and save a basic presentation
workflows.text: Instantiate Presentation, add shapes, format them, and save to .pptx using SaveFormat.PPTX.

workflows.name: Connect shapes with connectors
workflows.text: Add two AutoShapes and a connector, then wire them together using setStartShapeConnectedTo and setEndShapeConnectedTo.

workflows.name: Add threaded comments
workflows.text: Create a CommentAuthor, add a Comment with timestamp and position, and save the presentation.

workflows.name: Set document properties
workflows.text: Access IDocumentProperties through Presentation, set title/author/keywords, and save.

workflows.name: Apply visual effects
workflows.text: Enable outer shadow effect on a shape and configure blur radius, direction, distance, and color.

workflows.name: Add speaker notes
workflows.text: Create a NotesSlide via NotesSlideManager, set text content, and save the presentation.
